svg.title: Changing compartments can share a conserved total
svg.desc: Left and right ventricular volumes change during the final two cycles, while the sum over all six regions remains at its initialized 5.13616 liters across the complete 15-second calculation. All values are synthetic; total conservation does not prove clinical validity or time-step accuracy.
